blocks.text: # Kest-7 cooling unit
Kest-7 is installed in the north service bay. Its grey shell and amber status lamp are normal identifying marks.
A fast amber pulse immediately after a load transfer means thermal rebound. Record the transfer time before changing any setting.
## Restart rule
A Kest-7 may normally be restarted after its amber pulse slows and the casing is cool enough to touch.
Exception: if the casing remains hot or room pressure rises, isolate power first and do not restart the unit.
## Vela-2 mesh
The Vela-2 intake mesh can turn copper-grey while its intake fan continues running. This colour alone does not mean the fan failed.
It may be bypassed for no more than ninety seconds, but only while the intake fan remains active.
## Orin-4 pressure ring
Before touching an Orin-4 that shows a violet ring, complete both checks:

- Confirm that pressure is falling.
- Confirm that the auxiliary vent is open.
If either check fails, keep the unit isolated.
## Signal table

| Device | Signal | Required action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mira-3 | three brief blue flashes | use remote controls only |
| Rill-5 | steady white tone with no spectrum trace | inspect the sensor cable |
Table note: the Mira-3 remote-control rule applies only when room pressure is stable. If pressure is rising, isolate power instead.
For Aster-9, silver frost after a cold start means the auxiliary vent must remain closed until the frost clears.
## Similar but different equipment
For Aster-8, silver frost after a cold start requires opening the auxiliary vent immediately. This rule never applies to Aster-9.
## Lumen-6 polarity warning
Do not connect the backup cell when the Lumen-6 polarity mark is red. Wait until the mark is green, then connect it.
